subskill: count the ways to write an even number as a sum of two primes (unordered)
prompt: In how many different ways can 48 be written as the sum of two prime numbers? (Writing the same two primes in the other order does not count as a different way.)
explanation: The pairs are 5 + 43, 7 + 41, 11 + 37, 17 + 31 and 19 + 29: five ways.
solve: const P=n=>{if(n<2)return false;for(let d=2;d*d<=n;d++)if(n%d===0)return false;return true};let c=0;for(let a=2;a<=24;a++)if(P(a)&&P(48-a))c++;return String(c);

// stops checking at 12 and finds only 5 + 43, 7 + 41 and 11 + 37
return String(3);
distractor_solve.6:
// also counts 1 + 47, treating 1 as a prime
return String(6);
distractor_solve.10:
// counts each pair in both orders
return String(10);
